# Marc Charles

Marc Charles is a longtime, low-intensity Facebook contact who spans two
distinct registers: casual golf talk in 2018 and a warmer, more personal
2017 exchange touching on shared recovery and old music collaboration.

## Golf, September 2018

The bulk of the 85-message thread is a single September 23, 2018
conversation about golf — equipment upgrades ("nothing worse than an
aggressively competitive amateur golfer... yeah i mean as long as
you're having fun then there's really no need to sweat the numbers"),
scores creeping down from the 90s to the 80s with new clubs, and local
gossip about a nearby course, Springdale, possibly selling for $2.2
million. The exchange also captures a small real-time moment: Marc
flying a drone over the country club while golfing, with Dan spotting
the footage and the two identifying each other in it.

## Recovery and old music, 2017

Two 2017 exchanges carry more weight. In May, the two acknowledge
sobriety milestones directly — "I'm 7 years clean from opiates,"
Dan writes; "Thanks bud. 4 years in august," Marc replies — immediately
followed by a shared memory of using together ("I remember being so
faded in your basement") and Dan mentioning he'd just found a CD of
music the two had recorded together. In August, Dan follows up on a
mutual friend, "Mike Z" ([[wiki/people/mike-zollinger|Mike Zollinger]]), after learning Marc is
sponsoring him.

Discussed club tech (Franko customs, Taylormade), scores (90s to 85s), practice vs. fun mindset, competitive amateurs, local course sale rumors (Springdale), drone flights over the country club. - 2018 primary thread: golf equipment, scores, mindset ("fuck all that work"), local real estate/golf course (Springdale), drone footage over club while Marc on 18 green.

- 2017 threads: check-ins on mutual acquaintance (mike z), old music production ("CD of the songs we did"), shared history of heavy use ("ducking blasted", "faded in your basement"), sobriety acknowledgments.
- Ties to [[wiki/people/rj-ritchey]] golf/caddie network and PA returns.
- Periods: 2017-2018 (post-BFS, leisure/return-to-PA per [[wiki/timeline/periods/2018-deep-cycle]] and broader 2010s).
